plan: On the wide dry deck of a quiet coastal ferry at windy sunset, taking a careful step and turning toward a fluttering silk scarf held at two corners by separate hands. Sea horizon and copper clouds, full feet and head visible, one traveler only.
Green sleeveless V-neck wrap romper with flowing short legs, brown flat sandals and a narrow yellow silk scarf, bare shoulders arms and legs, small leaf bracelet.

In her warm apartment dressing nook at night, resting one forearm lightly on the vanity while choosing between two small leaf earrings placed far apart on the tabletop. Soft amber bulbs and deep green curtains, both hands visible below chest, one adult fashion moment.

Opaque lined honey satin longline camisole with secure lace-trim square neckline and slim straps, matching high-waist lounge shorts, short open green silk robe slipping naturally to elbows, bare shoulders arms and a narrow waist gap; fully covered chest and pelvis.

In a sunlit roller-skating rink before opening, balanced in a low squat while checking the buckle of one skate, the other hand open on her opposite knee. Face visible in side profile, head to knees framing includes both hands, mint reflected daylight and parquet floor.
Brown halter athletic crop top with secure broad neck strap, lemon pleated sport skort with opaque shorts underneath, green roller skates and small leaf clasp, bare arms midriff and legs.
